## Selected shortlist

Eight distinct ideas: seven explicitly free and one optional paid heritage visit. Transport, refreshments and optional purchases are not included in “free”. Ages labelled “DoNext fit” are editorial suggestions, not organiser admission rules. All visits require a responsible accompanying adult; no childcare is implied.

### B1 — Marvellous Makers: Make a Mini Museum

`checkedAt: 2026-09-13T08:21:26+01:00` · **high: dated programme plus series times**

Sunday **20 September, 11:00–15:00**. Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery, Chamberlain Square, B3 3DH. September programme explicitly assigns the mini-museum activity to the 20th; **free**, **drop-in**, **all ages**, adult supervision required. DoNext fit: particularly 4–12 for hands-on making; younger children need help. [Programme](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/events/marvellous-makers). [Official directions](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/birmingham-museum-and-art-gallery/visit/how-to-get-here): lift entrance via Gas Hall, Edmund Street.

### B2 — Helios at The Exchange

`checkedAt: 2026-09-13T08:21:26+01:00` · **medium: ongoing exhibition/opening timetable**

Weekday option **14–18 September** and Saturday **19 September**, **08:00–17:00**. The Exchange, 3 Centenary Square, B1 2DR. **Free, no ticket or booking**. Venue lists Monday–Saturday; do **not** suggest Sunday. No numerical age restriction listed; DoNext fit 0–12 with a grown-up, especially school-age space fans. Illuminated sculpture with soundscape, not a toddler class. Café closes 16:00; purchases optional. [Event and access details](https://www.birmingham.ac.uk/events/helios-by-luke-jerram); [season/opening timetable](https://www.birmingham.ac.uk/the-exchange/events/helios).

The March [university announcement](https://www.birmingham.ac.uk/news/2026/illuminated-sculpture-of-the-sun-goes-on-display-in-birmingham-city-centre) says 1 November; the current event page says 7 November. Both cover this draft window. Do not use an end-of-run urgency claim until that discrepancy is resolved. A search snippet mentioned a 19 September quiet hour, but the opened page did not substantiate it: no quiet-session claim in copy.

### R1 — South Bristol Arts Trail / Paper Play

`checkedAt: 2026-09-13T08:21:26+01:00` · **high: dated festival and Saturday programme**

Trail **19–20 September, 11:00–17:00**, across Southville, Bedminster and Ashton. **Free, open to everyone**. [Organiser dates](https://southbristolarts.co.uk/), [workshop timetable](https://southbristolarts.co.uk/workshops-performances/), [visit/access notes](https://southbristolarts.co.uk/visit/), [map](https://southbristolarts.co.uk/map/), [Tobacco Factory venue](https://tobaccofactory.com/). `checkedAt: 2026-09-13T08:21:26+01:00` · **medium: ongoing activity**
